title: Redis
comment: Redis's state is what lives in its `dir` -- dump.rdb and the appendonly files; the FreeBSD package points it at /var/db/redis (uid 535) and the official Linux image at /data. The Daemonless image runs redis-server with its own /config/redis.conf whose dir is /config/data, so the data directory carries there. The jail's redis.conf is deliberately NOT carried: its dir, bind and unixsocket settings name jail paths that are wrong inside the container -- the image configuration is authoritative and tuning is re-applied by hand. rc_data_var is deliberately absent: the only rc.conf variable (redis_config) names the CONFIG file, not the data directory.

drop: redis.conf: the image runs with its own defaults
redis.conf (the image configuration is authoritative; jail dir/bind/socket paths do not apply)
